alt.en: Static lookup gives train the same row. Forward and backward recurrent layers use left and right sentence context. A frozen pretrained language model supplies sentence-dependent features to a trainable task layer mixture and predictor.
alt.zh-hans: 静态查表为 train 返回同一行。正反向递归层分别使用句子的左右上下文。冻结的预训练语言模型产生随句子变化的特征，任务再学习层混合与预测器。

caption.en: Figure 12.2 — The same token has one embedding row but can have different sentence features; task parameters train separately.
caption.zh-hans: 图 12.2 — 同一个词的嵌入行相同，结合句子后表示可以不同；任务参数另行训练。
